field.name: ApprovalRequest repoPath, arguments, preview; CommonApprovalMode; approval.subscribe
field.type: ApprovalRequest gains repoPath: string, arguments: Record<string, unknown> and preview?: { title: string; content: string }; CommonApprovalMode = 'manual' | 'edit-auto' | 'auto'; ApprovalDenial gains 'cancelled'; IPC method approval.request (daemon to client) is realised as approval.subscribe (a client-opened stream carrying 'gate' frames) plus approval.answer
field.purpose: The request must name the repository and the exact arguments (DEF S003 FR001), the chat has three modes, and the daemon can push only over a stream the client opened. Additive refinements of a contract only s3 owns.
